description: This file defines classes related to tracking and counting frequent items within a data stream, specifically implementing a variant of the space-saving algorithm used for top-k element detection. It includes a specialized collection for edges, using hash-based keys, and employs a custom in-lined priority queue structure for efficiency.

classes.name: FrequentEdgeCounter
classes.description: A specialized collection for counting the frequency of edges, derived from a generic frequent item collection, using a hash-based key combining source and target node IDs.

classes.name: FrequentItemCollection`2
classes.description: An abstract generic class implementing a space-saving algorithm variant to track the most frequent items in a data stream, supporting add, remove, and clear operations, with internal heap and sketch structures for efficiency.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Computes a unique hash key for an edge based on source and target node IDs.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the collection, removing all tracked items.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a specified edge from the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an element (edge) to the collection, updating its frequency or inserting it if it is within the top-k.

methods.name: RemoveCore
methods.description: Internal method to remove items by key, updating internal data structures.

methods.name: ClearCore
methods.description: Internal method to clear all data structures.

methods.name: InsertHeap
methods.description: Inserts a new counter into the heap and updates internal index mappings.

methods.name: GrowHeap
methods.description: Expands the internal heap array to accommodate more elements.

methods.name: MoveUpHeap
methods.description: Restores heap order after an insertion by moving a node upward.

methods.name: MoveDownHeap
methods.description: Restores heap order after removal or update by moving a node downward.
